BoundChild.description: The child a token bound: the registering incarnation's own registry identity.

bound_at.description: When the edge bound to this incarnation.

registration_id.description: Exact registry identity returned to the registering child. Absent in legacy records.

Freshness.description: Freshness is independent of process identity or completion.

oneOf.description: Accepted in this serving epoch by the current writer and not expired.
Restored, reported by a replaced writer, retired, or expired.

PublicSpawnExitObservation.description: What a spawn topology read can say about a child's process exit.

PublicSpawnTopology.description:
One edge as a topology read reports it: the stored facts, plus the two things
a read derives instead of inferring.

freshness.description:
Freshness of the recorded location against this read's evidence, in the
registry's one freshness vocabulary: `fresh` when the backend reports the
location now, `stale` when it does not — which is never evidence that the
child stopped. Absent when the edge recorded no location, because there is
nothing to verify.

RegistryLocation.description:
Where an agent's incarnation lives on one backend, in that backend's own
coordinates.

The backend name is free-form so a source Radar does not ship yet is
preserved rather than rejected; the rest are the coordinates as reported, and
each is optional because a backend need not name every level.

oneOf.description: The operation ran and its effects are in the record.
The operation did not run, and the record says why.
Execution began and the daemon cannot say what it did.

SpawnState.description:
The state of one edge in the recorded topology: the strongest statement a
read can make about it, and nothing beyond the records and this read's own
evidence.

oneOf.description:
No child has presented this edge's token. The edge may still be pending,
or its launch may never have reached a shell.

A child registered with this edge's token, so the edge names its exact
identity. Observation does not revise this.

The recorded location is not in the backend's own report: the record and
the world disagree. This is never a statement that the child stopped — a
read observes panes, and a pane's absence is not a process's death.

description: One page of spawn edges. `next` names the request id the page ended on.
